concepts.def: Catholic conspiracy led by Robert Catesby; Guy Fawkes caught beneath Lords with 36 barrels of gunpowder.
Parliament's statement against Charles I's forced loans, arbitrary imprisonment and martial law; Charles dissolved parliament 1629.
Charles I's tax on coastal counties extended inland 1635; Hampden's 1637 legal challenge mobilised opposition.
30 January beheading at Whitehall after Rump Parliament trial; first regicide of an anointed European king.
Charles II returned after Cromwell's death and Monck's march; Declaration of Breda promised religious toleration.
William of Orange invited to replace James II; Bill of Rights (1689) established constitutional monarchy.
